candidates.title: Fire brigade holds emergency drill on elevated metro section
candidates.search_snippet: The city fire brigade and the metro operator held an emergency response drill at the line's depot on Tuesday.
candidates.source_content: The city fire brigade and the metro operator held an emergency response drill at the line's depot on Tuesday. About 60 firefighters and metro staff rehearsed reaching a stalled train on the elevated section with an aerial ladder, extinguishing an initial fire, evacuating passengers with the on-board escape chute and cutting traction power; no actual incident occurred.
